purpose: Test whether replacing P0685's centrally singular local path ratio with one scale-free baryonic system coordinate preserves the spent galaxy/cluster radial response while enforcing a centrally concentrated channel exponent suitable for a later 3D topology retry.
failure_anatomy: P0685 local eta suppresses the inner exponent: median p rises from 1.28 inside 15 kpc to 2.71 at 150-225 kpc; P0686 loses image roots and multiplicity while both shear nuisances hit their bounds

predeclared_variants.global_system_primary: use eta_sys at every radius; only this variant may advance
predeclared_variants.local_P0685_control: use local eta_b(r), reproducing the failed P0685 radial operator
predeclared_variants.capped_local_diagnostic: use min[eta_b(r),eta_sys], preventing the central divergence while retaining lower local path ratios; cannot advance from P0687

spent_galaxy_test.potential_closure: existing outer baryonic profile integration plus point-mass tail
spent_galaxy_test.system_coordinate_limit: eta_sys is estimated on the available spent scored baryonic profile; this is a development screen, not a full-disk field calculation

spent_cluster_test.target: mean baryonic reduced deflection plus mean radial compact-halo deflection in each P0682 annular bin
spent_cluster_test.prediction: spherical line-of-sight deflection at reference source redshift z=2

solar_proxy.warning: force screening is not a covariant PPN or Cassini-gamma derivation

selection_rule: The global-system formula advances only if it passes every frozen galaxy, both cluster, gap-closure, Solar, baryon-only, parameter-accounting, and nonpositive-exponent-slope gate. Diagnostic variants map the response only and cannot be promoted post hoc. No constant is selected in P0687.
claim_boundary: P0687 is generated from a fully spent RX J2129 topology failure and cannot validate the replacement.
eta_sys is nonlocal but derived only from the baryonic field; its covariant meaning is not established.
The spent galaxy estimate uses the available scored baryonic profile rather than a new full-disk 3D solve.
A radial pass is only permission to freeze a new registered 3D topology test, not evidence that topology will pass.
No sealed P0633 or P0640 outcome may be opened.
